# Frontend view palette

Manifests and registries describe supported view types, configuration, and rendering. Keep backend validation and generated contract artifacts aligned when adding or changing a type.

Use shared authorized relation/member/file presentation and explicit state handling. Package composites resolve to supported bases; iframe extension views use their declared host boundary.

Read the [palette guide](../../../docs/operational-models/VIEW_PALETTE.md) and [component guide](../../../docs/operational-models/UI_COMPONENTS_GUIDE.md).
